title: T-Handle Broad-Flight Soil Auger
description: One newly authored static low-poly T-handle soil-auger-inspired prop: a long continuous metal core with a small blunt flat lower end, one complete thick two-turn broad helical flight around its lower portion, and one transverse rounded wooden grip. The broad separate helical wing is new mesh geometry, not an extracted or enlarged fluted bench-drill bit; no old dibber geometry is reused. Three closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR materials. Whole horizontal bounds-centred, metres, Z-up. Fixed game-art appearance only; no turning, soil boring, cutting performance, manufacturing, structural, ergonomic or safety claims.
